title: Kea listener must await asyncActions.loadX (not actions.loadX) to keep optimistic state until refresh completes
answers: Removed reviewer briefly reappears in inbox after removal
Reviewer flicker while updating suggested reviewers
Optimistic state cleared before loader finishes in kea listener
body:
Symptom: After removing a reviewer in the web inbox report detail, the reviewer briefly reappears until the refreshed list loads.
Root cause: products/signals/frontend/inbox/logics/inboxReportDetailLogic.ts:updateReviewers listener did `await actions.loadReportArtefacts()`. Kea `actions.*` returns immediately (not a promise for the loader), so the `finally` block cleared the optimistic reviewer state before the server refresh arrived.
Fix pattern: destructure `asyncActions` in `listeners(({ actions, asyncActions, values, props }) => ...)` and `await asyncActions.loadReportArtefacts()` so the finally/cleanup runs only after the loader completes. Failure path still restores the previous list via catch/finally.
Constraints: applies to any kea listener that must sequence work after a loader finishes. Does not apply when the optimistic state needn't outlive the refresh. `isUpdatingReviewers` stays true (further edits disabled) during the wait.
applies: Kea logics in products/signals/frontend/inbox/logics, and any listener awaiting a loader/action
says: Removed code reviewer briefly appears again after I delete them.
Team member flickers on-screen while updating suggested reviewers.
Optimistic updates clear before the server refresh finishes loading.
Why does the UI show stale data after I remove a reviewer?
Waiting for refresh to complete before clearing temporary state.
